{{Quote|The hunter we're after is named Rarsk. He's a Trandoshan and serious bad news. Burned a whole village alive on Dantooine.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="Sponsorship" />}}
'''Rarsk''' was a fearsome [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who burned an entire village alive on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he received the sponsorship of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] to enter the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] competition.

While trying to collect a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Albea]] in [[Fa'athra's Palace]] on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], Rarsk was confronted by another [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who Nem'ro had also promised to sponsor. The rival hunter then [[Death/Legends|killed]] Rarsk and took the sponsorship token from him.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Hello, soft things. I see many Fa'athra servants are dead. Give me the scientist female, and you will not join them.|Rarsk, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="Sponsorship" />}}
The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Rarsk was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He burned an entire village alive on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Sponsorship" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he earned the sponsorship token of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] to join the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunting competition. [[Graata]], a representative of the Great Hunt who was due to arrive shortly in [[Nem'ro's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], then contacted Rarsk via transmission. The Trandoshan then headed to the [[Fa'athra's Palace|palace]] of Nem'ro's rival, [[Voontara Fa'athra]], who was holding the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Albea]] for the bounty hunter. Rarsk intended to collect on the bounty and deliver Albea to the Empire, who wanted her [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="Sponsorship" />

Inside the palace, Rarsk discovered that many of Fa'athra's servants had been killed, and entered the lab where Albea was being kept with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] drawn and two [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] backing him up. Laying in wait for him in the lab, Rarsk found the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] and another [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who Nem'ro had promised sponsorship to. Nem'ro had told the hunter to kill Rarsk in order to obtain the sponsorship token, and Mako had intercepted Rarsk's transmission with Graata to learn about Albea and allow them to reach her before the Trandoshan. Rarsk threatened to kill the pair if they did not hand the bounty over, but the other hunter countered by demanding that Rarsk hand over the token. With neither backing down, Rarsk attacked, but he and the Abyssins were killed and the token taken from his corpse.<ref name="Sponsorship" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
The surviving bounty hunter then killed Albea in order to also claim the bounty on her.<ref name="Sponsorship" />
{{Endgame}}

The bounty hunter and Mako then met with Graata at Nem'ro's Palace, who was surprised to not be meeting Rarsk, but gave the instructions he intended to deliver to the Trandoshan to his replacement instead. Nem'ro was satisfied that he was now sponsoring the most dangerous bounty hunter on Nal Hutta and so the bounty hunter left to participate in,<ref name="Sponsorship" /> and ultimately win, the Great Hunt.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Someone fierce and deadly on Hutta has the sponsorship token.|translated=1|Nem'ro describes Rarsk|<ref name="Sponsorship" />}}
Rarsk was considered a deadly and fearsome hunter by Nem'ro, who believed him to be the most dangerous hunter on Nal Hutta until he was killed. The Trandoshan referred to members of other species as "soft things" and believed them to be stupid. He believed in the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]] and asked her to watch him when he fought. Rarsk was unwilling to trade his sponsorship token for Albea, believing he could simply kill his foes instead of making a deal. He spoke in [[Dosh/Legends|Dosh]] and had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin.<ref name="Sponsorship" />

==Equipment==
Rarsk wore a brown and red [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] with a brown [[Clothing/Legends|vest]] and a gray [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. He wore a brown [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] and used a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol, a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]], a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]], a retractable blade, and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] in combat.<ref name="Sponsorship" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rarsk appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an enemy in the bounty hunter class campaign.<ref name="Sponsorship" />
